verdict.rationale: Hands-on probes confirm a live llms.txt at docs.galileo.ai that indexes 195 documentation pages, and every docs page is served as Markdown (.md) with a header telling agents to fetch the llms.txt index. The many .md doc URLs cited elsewhere show the agent-readable format is used across the docs site. Missing for 10: independent or community corroboration of agents using these docs effectively, and no machine-readable OpenAPI spec (all probed paths returned 404).
